headline: When to Call a General Contractor for Your Full Home Remodel
articleBody:
Thinking about updating several rooms at once? It is easy to wonder if you can manage individual handymen or if you need a licensed general contractor to take the lead. Here are clear signals it is time to bring in professional general contracting oversight:

- Your project involves removing load-bearing walls or changing interior floor plans to create open-concept living.
- You are updating wiring, main panels, or rough plumbing across kitchens, basements, and multiple bathrooms.
- Municipal permits and formal building inspections are required by your local building department.
- You do not have the time to schedule, supervise, and coordinate multiple separate specialty trade crews.
- Hidden structural or moisture issues appear once existing walls or subfloors are opened up.

When multiple trades converge on your house at once, a licensed contractor keeps work compliant, safe, and on schedule. 

If your remodel involves structural changes or complex systems, call Blue Lake Construction at 385-202-5987 to review your plans and get professional guidance.
